**Every block of a mod within reach.** The Blocks panel showed only a mod's whole blocks at first, and sorted many of its blocks under Other: a tester with Regions Unexplored found a couple of leaves and a few terrain blocks out of hundreds. A block whose name says nothing of its family is now sorted by how it is drawn (a mod's flowers and crops with the plants, its fences, doors and signs with the wood), plants show beside the whole blocks without ticking **All shapes**, and the search looks through every block and shape. With Biomes O' Plenty, 215 of its 429 blocks show at first instead of 119; with Oh The Biomes We've Gone, 536 of 965 instead of 311. For a block nothing finds, type its id under the search, with its properties if it has any (`mod:block[axis=x]`), and paint it **As terrain** or grow it **As cover**: a block Massif has not read is written as typed and drawn in grey.
